criteria.criterion: every archetype passes the structural gate and independent review with no open blocker/major finding and a second verification
every ledger series has exactly one final assignment (reconciles exactly)
every in-scope series is assigned to an archetype that exists in the catalog
every review-added input is audited (definition, provenance, market-free class)
no catalog blocker remains open (a blocker closes only with a verified change to existing catalog ids)
no interaction, non-linearity or mechanism stage names an input its archetype does not carry (detached-input references)

acceptance.note: Meeting the documented criteria is necessary, not sufficient, and is never approval. Reviewers and verifiers are Claude agents, not human domain experts.

approval.approved_by: project owner (chmoses98), by instruction to the research session
approval.decision_text: I accept the SIFT Alpha catalog-completeness milestone at commit 50dc65e as our research baseline. This is approval of the catalog blueprint only, not human expert verification, predictive readiness, or authorization to place bets. Preserve all 1,030 declared gaps and their uncertainty.
does_not_assert: human domain-expert verification of any archetype, input, mechanism, interaction or contract reading
that any of the 1,030 declared gaps is resolved or that the catalog is complete
data readiness (the data foundation audit has not been independently verified)
predictive readiness or any profitability, edge or calibration claim
authorization to place bets, submit live orders or change any betting authority
approval.predictive_experimentation: PAUSED until an independently verified data-readiness assessment exists and the owner lifts the pause by editing phase_control.json

preserved_at_approval.note: The 65 CATALOG_BLOCKER gaps are recorded as closed by agent verification; the other 965 declared gaps and all uncertainty flags remain open by design.

approval.recorded_by: Claude Code research session (recording the owner's instruction; this file records a human decision and is never produced by the generators)
approval.verification_basis: All reviews, audits and second verifications behind this baseline were done by Claude agents. No human domain expert verified the catalog. This approval is an owner's acceptance of the blueprint as a working baseline, not a verification of its factual content.

criteria: structure valid (13-category mechanism coverage, staged mechanism, >=4 interactions incl. form+test, >=2 nonlinearities, required-data definitions with sources and access)
every pre-existing archetype input individually audited (keep/weak/duplicate/irrelevant/benchmark-only with a reason)
contract text: verbatim quotes from sampled Kalshi rules for >=2 series where rules exist; ledger-checked tickers; edge cases listed
no boilerplate: stage and interaction text not near-duplicated across archetypes (5-gram Jaccard < 0.35)
at least one explicit unresolved gap per archetype (no archetype may be declared complete)
independent second review recorded with no open BLOCKER/MAJOR finding
second independent verification (different model) of every closed blocker/major finding: each CONFIRMED or CORRECTED, none REOPENED
records edited by the reconcile pass (series re-filed, rules text recovered) are re-audited by an independent verifier after the edit
READY_FOR_USER_APPROVAL is the ceiling: the human decision lives in approval.json and is never written by code
